title.description: The label of a sermon's title: the field of a sermon's page, and what the search of the sermons names the field it filters on.

speaker.description: The label of who preached a sermon: the field of a sermon's page, and what the search of the sermons names the field it filters on.

status.description: The label of whether a sermon reaches the site, a draft, published or archived: the field of a sermon's page, and what the search of the sermons names the field it filters on.

preached.description: The label of the day a sermon was preached: the field of a sermon's page, and what the search of the sermons names the field it filters on.

picture.description: The label of the field of a sermon's page for the URL of its picture. One left empty is pictured by a frame of its recording.

video.description: The label of the field of a sermon's page for YouTube's id for its recording.

recording.description: The heading over a sermon's recording, played on its page.

unrecorded.description: What stands in the place of a sermon's recording on its page when it has none.

body.description: The heading over what is written about a sermon, on its page.

bodyEmpty.defaultMessage: Nothing is written about this sermon yet.
bodyEmpty.description: What stands in for what is written about a sermon, on its page, when there is nothing.
